evaluation: Phase 7.1a bounded initial real-provider evaluation (--preset initial-real)

consumed_generations.basis: both attempts ran the same deterministic order; the crash point (measurement of the 5th reply, kore on scenario_4_selective_attention) is only reachable after that request returned successfully. The 4 earlier requests per attempt were sent; whether each succeeded was not recorded.

why_outputs_were_lost: metrics.automated_checks looked the answering companion up in the scenario's own cast; under a cast override (kore is not in scenario_4_selective_attention's cast) that raised StopIteration, which escaped the run as 'coroutine raised StopIteration'.
the result document was written only after the whole run, so replies already received were discarded with the process.
the second attempt was intended as a zero-generation check, but the CLI read --max-generations 0 as 'unset' and applied the preset's 12.
fixes: companion spec carried with each reply; no scenario lookup in measurement
generation ledger: request persisted before each call, reply persisted on return (fsync per line)
--resume replays recorded replies; unanswered requests are not re-sent without --retry-unanswered
budget counts all earlier requests, including these 10 (this directory's ledger)
--max-generations / --max-output-tokens below 1 rejected; provider runs require an explicit bound
an existing ledger is never overwritten; a different configuration cannot resume it
owner_decision: 2026-11-08: do not run further real generations now; the ~10 lost generations count against the authorization; do not restart the 12-generation evaluation; do not reconstruct lost replies. The complete 30-scenario evaluation is to be considered after Phase 7 integration.
